new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Punchhi Commission's recommendations on the Governor:
1. The Governor should have a fixed tenure of five years.
2. The Governor should be removed only by impeachment by the State Legislature.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Punchhi wanted a fixed five-year tenure and removal only by impeachment by the State Legislature, like the President's impeachment.
new.angle: U0331 #2 / PYQ y5d0d19923e9 Governor tenure and removal

new.s: Which Article of the Constitution did the Punchhi Commission want amended to delete the words 'during the pleasure of the President'?
new.x: Article 156 says the Governor holds office during the pleasure of the President; Punchhi wanted these words deleted.

new.s: According to the Punchhi Commission, how often should the Inter-State Council meet?
new.x: Punchhi recommended that the Inter-State Council meet at least thrice a year.

new.s: Which of the following bodies recommended an Inter-State Council to be consulted on matters of national importance?
new.x: The Rajamannar Committee (1969), set up by Tamil Nadu, recommended such an Inter-State Council.
new.angle: U0331 N1 commission comparison -> Inter-State Council

new.s: According to the Punchhi Commission, from where should the Governor of a State be appointed?
o: From among the members of the State Legislature
From among the members of the Rajya Sabha
new.x: Punchhi endorsed the Sarkaria norm that the Governor should be from outside the State, with the CM consulted.
new.angle: U0331 notes gap Governor from outside State

new.s: How many recommendations did the Punchhi Commission make in its report?
new.x: The Punchhi report (2010) had 7 volumes and 273 recommendations.

new.s: Who succeeded M. Veerappa Moily as Chairman of the Second Administrative Reforms Commission in 2009?
new.x: The Second ARC was first chaired by Veerappa Moily; V. Ramachandran took over after Moily left in 2009.
new.angle: U0332 #2 / PYQ y78a58b474ef Second ARC chairman

new.s: Which of the following is the odd one out with respect to the subject it dealt with?
new.x: Sarkaria, Rajamannar and Punchhi dealt with Centre-State relations; Liberhan inquired into the 1992 Babri Masjid demolition.
new.angle: U0332 #1 committees -> subject odd one out

new.s: Who was the Chairman of the National Commission to Review the Working of the Constitution (NCRWC)?
new.x: The NCRWC (2000-02) was chaired by Justice M.N. Venkatachaliah.

new.s: On whose recommendation was the Inter-State Council set up in 1990 under Article 263?
new.x: The Inter-State Council was set up in 1990 on the advice of the Sarkaria Commission.
new.angle: U0332 notes gap ISC -> recommending body

new.s: Which report of the Second Administrative Reforms Commission dealt with Local Governance?
new.x: The Second ARC's 6th report was on Local Governance, covering devolution to PRIs and ULBs.

new.s: Who was the first Chairman of the First Administrative Reforms Commission set up in 1966?
new.x: The First ARC was first chaired by Morarji Desai and later by K. Hanumanthaiah.

new.s: Who is the Chairman of the Inter-State Council?
new.x: The Inter-State Council under Article 263 is chaired by the Prime Minister.

new.s: Who chairs all the five Zonal Councils set up under the States Reorganisation Act, 1956?
o: Chief Minister of the host State
new.x: All five Zonal Councils are chaired by the Union Home Minister.

new.s: Who described the Indian federation as one with a centralising tendency?
new.x: Ivor Jennings called India a federation with a strong centralising tendency.

new.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Under competitive federalism, States compete with each other and with the Centre to draw investment.
2. NITI Aayog's State rankings push States to improve social and development indicators.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: States compete for investment, and rankings push them to improve indicators linked to SDG targets.

new.s: What was Andhra Pradesh's rank in NITI Aayog's Fiscal Health Index 2023-24?
new.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked 17th in the Fiscal Health Index 2023-24.

new.s: Which State won the most National Panchayat Awards 2025, finishing ahead of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Karnataka won 6 awards; Andhra Pradesh won 5, tied with Odisha.

new.s: Who is the Chairperson of NITI Aayog?
new.x: The Prime Minister is the Chairperson of NITI Aayog; it has no full-time Chairman.

new.s: Who among the following used the term 'democratic decentralisation'?
new.x: Democratic decentralisation, the move of power to elected local bodies, is Balwant Rai Mehta's term.

new.s: Who constitutes the State Finance Commission under Article 243I?
new.x: The SFC is constituted by the Governor; the Union Finance Commission is constituted by the President under Article 280.

new.s: Who chaired Andhra Pradesh's Fourth State Finance Commission, the first after bifurcation?
new.x: The 4th AP SFC was chaired by Prof. G. Nancharaiah and reported on 30 October 2019.

new.s: Which of the following was recommended by Andhra Pradesh's Fifth State Finance Commission (2025-30)?
o: Extra help to local bodies with low per capita income
Abolition of property tax in Gram Panchayats
Merger of Gram Panchayats with municipalities
Immediate transfer of all 29 Eleventh Schedule subjects
new.x: The 5th SFC sought extra help for low per capita income local bodies and State matching grants to Central FC grants.

new.s: Who headed the Local Finance Enquiry Committee (1949-51)?
new.x: The Local Finance Enquiry Committee (1949-51) was headed by P.K. Wattal.

new.s: What share of the divisible pool did the Thirteenth Finance Commission give to the States?
new.x: The 13th FC gave 32%; the 14th raised it to 42% and the 15th set 41%.

new.s: What weight did the Fifteenth Finance Commission give to demographic performance in horizontal devolution?
new.x: The 15th FC gave demographic performance a weight of 12.5%.

new.s: Which State topped the Functions dimension of the 2024 Devolution Index?
new.x: Tamil Nadu topped Functions, Karnataka Finances and Gujarat Functionaries in the 2024 Index.

new.s: Which agency conducts the drone survey under the SVAMITVA scheme?
new.x: SVAMITVA drone mapping is done by the Survey of India to give a 'Record of Rights'.

new.s: What is the name of the portal used to monitor works under MPLADS?
new.x: MPLADS works are tracked on the eSAKSHI portal.

new.s: On which date was eGramSwaraj launched along with the SVAMITVA scheme?
new.x: eGramSwaraj was launched with SVAMITVA on 24 April 2020.

new.s: Who was the first Chief Election Commissioner of India?
new.x: Sukumar Sen was the first CEC (1950-58).

new.s: Since which year has 25 January been observed as National Voters' Day?
new.x: National Voters' Day marks the ECI's founding on 25 January 1950 and has been observed since 2011.

new.s: Who delivered the first Sukumar Sen Memorial Lecture of the Election Commission in January 2020?
new.x: The first Sukumar Sen Memorial Lecture was given by Pranab Mukherjee on 23 January 2020.

new.s: On whose recommendation can the President remove an Election Commissioner from office?
new.x: ECs and Regional Commissioners can be removed only on the CEC's recommendation.
new.angle: U0336 #1 removal of CEC vs ECs

new.s: Who chairs the Selection Committee for the CEC and Election Commissioners under the 2023 Act?
new.x: The Selection Committee is the PM (chair), the LoP in Lok Sabha and a Cabinet Minister nominated by the PM.

new.s: In which case did the Supreme Court describe Article 324 as a 'reservoir of power'?
o: Mohinder Singh Gill v. Chief Election Commissioner
T.N. Seshan v. Union of India
Anoop Baranwal v. Union of India
ADR v. Election Commission of India
new.x: Mohinder Singh Gill (1978) called Article 324 a reservoir of power, usable where no law holds the field.

new.s: In which case was it held that the Model Code of Conduct applies from the day the election schedule is announced?
new.x: The Harbans Singh Jalal case (1997) held that the MCC applies from the announcement of the schedule.

new.s: What is the purpose of SVEEP of the Election Commission of India?
o: Registration help for persons with disabilities
new.x: SVEEP is the ECI's voter awareness and education programme for inclusive elections.

new.s: Under which Article can laws on delimitation and allotment of seats not be questioned in any court?
new.x: Article 329(a) bars courts from questioning delimitation and seat allotment laws.

new.s: Which institute in New Delhi is the training arm of the Election Commission of India?
new.x: The India International Institute of Democracy and Election Management (IIIDEM) is the ECI's training arm.
